home.heading: Welcome
home.intro: The platform is intended for physicians, residents and medical students. It presents echocardiography parameters, reference values and calculators with their sources.
home.notDiagnostic: This site does not provide individual diagnoses or treatment decisions.
home.privacy: Patient name, ID and date of birth are neither requested nor stored. Measurements you enter stay in your browser only.

sections.echo: Chambers, walls, valves, hemodynamics, right heart, pericardium, aorta and pulmonary artery (in ASE/EACVI order).
sections.calculators: EF (Teichholz, Simpson), LV mass index (Devereux) and RWT, E/A and E/e', PASP.
sections.assistant: Educational assistant that explains formulas and parameters. It does not diagnose.
sections.plans: Plans and subscription (currently in test mode).
sections.account: Registration, roles and physician license verification.

disclaimer.text: For educational purposes. Clinical decisions are made by a qualified physician.
